advancement.tentaworks.doc_rig.desc: Get a Tentacle Rig: four Tentacles on a Backtank
enchantment.tentaworks.far_reach.desc: Longer Tentacles: more Reach per level, so the Rig grips, hangs and climbs from farther away.
enchantment.tentaworks.swift.desc: The Rig carries you faster: more Speed and a higher top Speed per level.
enchantment.tentaworks.thrift.desc: The Rig uses less Air per level while holding, moving and climbing.
item.tentaworks.copper_tentacle_rig.tool: _Double Jump_ to activate. Move where you look, _Space_ up, _Shift_ down. _Double Jump_ again to be _Set Down_.
Opens the _Rig Settings_: _Standing Height_, _Speed_ and _Activation Mode_.
Refills under a spinning _shaft_ like any Backtank. Picked up again with its _Air_ and settings.
A _Backtank_ fitted with four _Tentacles_. Worn, it carries you over _floors, walls and ceilings_ on its _Air_. Copper: _shorter Reach_.
item.tentaworks.netherite_tentacle_rig.t: _Double Jump_ to activate. Move where you look, _Space_ up, _Shift_ down. _Double Jump_ again to be _Set Down_.
Opens the _Rig Settings_: _Standing Height_, _Speed_ and _Activation Mode_.
Refills under a spinning _shaft_ like any Backtank. Picked up again with its _Air_ and settings.
A _Backtank_ fitted with four _Tentacles_. Worn, it carries you over _floors, walls and ceilings_ on its _Air_. Netherite: _longer Reach_, uses _half the Air_.
item.tentaworks.tentacle.tooltip.summary: One pneumatic arm of a _Tentacle Rig_. Four of them, a _Backtank_ and a _Precision Mechanism_ make a Rig on _Mechanical Crafters_.
tentaworks.goggles.no_shaft: Not filling: needs a turning shaft above
tentaworks.gui.rig_settings.double_jump_: Double Jump: activate, Set Down, let go
tentaworks.gui.rig_settings.speed.hint: How fast the Rig carries you while Active
tentaworks.gui.rig_settings.standing_hei: How high the Rig lifts you above the floor on activation
tentaworks.gui.rig_settings.title: Rig Settings: %s
tentaworks.ponder.tag.tentacle_rigs.desc: Worn Backtanks with four pneumatic Tentacles that carry you over floors, walls and ceilings
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_1: A Tentacle Rig is built on Mechanical Crafters: a Backtank in the middle, four Tentacles at the corners
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_10: Double Jump again to be Set Down: the Rig lowers you to the floor and Stows. With no floor in Reach, it lets go
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_11: Out of Air, the Rig only Crawls slowly down to the nearest floor. Refill it in time
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_2: The Rig lands on the depot. A Netherite Backtank makes a Netherite Rig: longer Reach, half the Air
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_3: Use a Rig on a block to place it. A placed Rig is a Backtank
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_4: A turning shaft above refills its Air. This is the only way to refill a Rig
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_5: Use it with an empty hand to pick it up again, with its Air, enchantments and settings
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_6: Worn in the chest slot, the Rig carries you. Double Jump to activate it
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_7: Tentacles grip floors, walls and ceilings. You move where you look, Space goes up, Sneak goes down
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_8: Look up at a wall to climb it. The hands stay free the whole time
tentaworks.ponder.tentacle_rig.text_9: Under a ledge the Rig simply hangs on. Holding still, moving and climbing all use the Backtank's Air
tentaworks.rig.worn_out: Worn out: repair it with %s at an anvil, or by Mending
tentaworks.rig.worn_out.warning: Tentacle Rig worn out: repair it
